about.heading: About Me
about.p1: I have partnered with organizations across Latin America, the Caribbean, and the United States to turn data into a competitive advantage. From shaping enterprise data strategies and building analytics platforms to accelerating AI adoption, I've guided governments and global enterprises in Financial Services, Oil & Gas, Retail, and Healthcare through their most critical digital transformation initiatives.
about.p2: Beyond my technical work, I'm deeply committed to community building and education — as a core team member of the Data & AI Community of Costa Rica, leading HOLA Academy, delivering technical courses to NGOs in Costa Rica, and empowering Hispanic and Latinx communities in tech.

bio.short: Diego Diaz Rodriguez is a Solutions Engineer for Azure Data & AI at Microsoft with more than 7 years of experience in cloud computing. He helps organizations across Latin America, the Caribbean, and the United States turn data into a competitive advantage. A Microsoft Certified Trainer, Diego is a core team member of the Data & AI Community of Costa Rica and leads HOLA Academy.
bio.long_hint: ~150 words · ideal for introductions by a host
bio.long: Diego Diaz Rodriguez is a Solutions Engineer for Azure Data & AI at Microsoft, with more than 7 years of experience in cloud computing across Microsoft, Accenture (N3), and IBM. He has partnered with governments and global enterprises in Financial Services, Oil & Gas, Retail, and Healthcare across Latin America, the Caribbean, and the United States — shaping enterprise data strategies, building analytics platforms with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, and accelerating AI adoption. Diego holds more than 12 certifications, including Azure Solutions Architect Expert and Azure AI Engineer Associate, and is a Microsoft Certified Trainer. Beyond his technical work, he is a core team member of the Data & AI Community of Costa Rica, leads HOLA Academy — an initiative that empowers Hispanic and Latinx communities in tech — and volunteers as a Change Agent with Fundación Grítalo. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology from Universidad Cenfotec.
